title: Publish the production release of the approved candidate
objective: Promote the founder-approved commit to the production Cloudflare Worker and confirm the deployed version reports the approved source SHA.

include: one production deployment of the approved commit

dependencies.note: Approved pull request and its exact head SHA.

required_approval.note: Approval is valid only for the head SHA named in the digest.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The production worker serves the approved commit.
A rollback target is recorded before the deployment starts.

verification.notes: Deployment is the deliverable here; it is never automatic.

rollback.instructions: Redeploy the recorded prior deployment identifier. Rollback is a founder-executed action; the agent may only report the target.
